profile.headline: Software Development Engineer at CrowdStrike

positions.title: Software Development Engineer (Contract)
positions.description:
• Introduces best development practices for maintainable, enterprise Go projects to development teams.
• Engineers a variety of platform and security services focused around OAuth2, including grant flow handlers, reverse proxies, token minters and other REST/gRPC services. 
• Augment CI/CD pipeline with dependency resolution, automated testing and multi-stage builds.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed web-advertising services including critical geocoding processes and customer products, with an emphasis on reliability, visibility and performance. 
•	Lead update of core applications to gRPC on Go, orchestrated via Terraform and CloudFormation.
•	Architected caching microservices to delegate and relieve back pressure on internal APIs. 
•	Designed and implemented a service that identifies both customer geolocation and web store SKUs that are viewed and not bought, without the use of cookies. 
•	Mentored junior engineers in best development, deployment and maintenance practices.  
•	Advocated for Agile practices in a startup environment to ensure quality products reach production quickly and safely.

positions.title: Business Analyst - Data and Workforce Management
positions.description:
•	Implemented a data pipeline from various inventory databases using Python and Apache Airflow. 
•	Created a digital signage application with Raspberry Pi used in over a dozen warehouses.
•	Modeled peak staffing strategy, resulting in over 20,000 hires over an 8-week period. 
•	Collaborated with directors to fortify workforce productivity with meaningful data.  
•	Generated six-figure clawbacks by identifying previously unenforced vendor SLA violations.

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description:
• Supervised billing office systems of two academic medical centers in Texas, with projects
including SBO integration, ICD-10 implementation and various upgrades.
• Interpreted client development requests and managed projects with a team of developers.
• Stabilized the charge conversion process at implementing hospitals by emphasizing
communication, testing and client engagement, resulting in dozens of successful projects.
• Consulted with business office to implement best practices for contracts, charge router
configuration, workflow management and financial metrics reporting.
• Developed reports and utilities in Cache and SQL to provide analysis of nightly processing
system integrity, identify workable AR and audit contracts.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•  Compiled comprehensive election data for over 30 countries in order to analyze relationships between religious political parties, electoral results and policy moderation 
•  Administered human experiment concerning insurance, risk preference, and decision making 
•  Synthesized a research summary on the influence of monetary policy as a means of financial regulation and the impact of indirect financing on regulatory structures

company.name: Political Science Department of the University of Wisconsin-Madison

positions.title: Legislative Intern
positions.description:
•Analyzed legislation and provided policy recommendations for votes and cosponsorships based on policy and constituent interest
•Researched and composed dozens of memos for the Congressman and staff ranging from policy overviews, to committee hearings, briefings, and current events 
•Managed and responded to hundreds of constituent contacts in the areas of banking, finance, taxes, labor, trade, the economy, and the judiciary

positions.title: Legislative Intern
positions.description:
•  Developed intern manual and training procedures for new interns 
•  Researched and communicated answers to constituents’ concerns on legislation and casework 
•  Maintained and updated constituent and legislative files, answered phones, and greeted visitors

company.name: The Office of State Senator Chris Larson

positions.title: Campaign Intern, GOTV Deputy
positions.description:
•  Utilized Votebuilder demographic technology to assemble hundreds of GOTV canvass packets
•  Managed over 200 volunteers and prepared off-site staging locations

positions.title: Campaign Intern, GOTV Coodinator
positions.description:
• Interpreted demographics and polling data to identify areas of potential swing voters to increase voter 
outreach using Votebuilder technology 
•  Recruited, trained, and organized hundreds of volunteers for phone bank and canvassing campaigns
•  Canvassed low-income areas of inner city Milwaukee to register eligible voters

honors.title: Startup Weekend - 2nd Place Pitch
honors.issuer: Issued by Techstars Startup Weekend · Oct 2017

organizations.name: Citizen's Police Academy
organizations.description: Attended Louisville's Citizen's Police Academy, a program that engages law enforcement and the metropolitan community.

organizations.name: Alexander Hamilton Society
organizations.description:
-Partnered with student organizations to put on a debate between College Democrats and College Republicans attended by over 100 students
-Directed a number of guest lectures and foreign policy seminars
-Hosted and organized a monthly foreign policy discussion group
